title: Last application version crushes on Android 16
body:
Hi,

I’m used to download the code in “.zip” format and create a new APK in fullRelease mode for my current phone running Android 14, version 3.3.1.2.

I need to switch smartphone now.
When I try to do the same thing described above (so download the ".zip", compile it and create the new APK in fullRelease mode) on my new phone running Android 16, with the last AAPS version available (currently 3.4.2.3, but also tried with few others behind) Android Studio generates the APK as usual with no errors, but when I install the appplication on the new phone, it opens and then closes immediately by its own.

I’ve tried few solutions, such as:
- Installing the new AAPS APK
- Then grant all permissions (location, Bluetooth, no battery saver mode/restrictions)
- Then open the app
But the result is always the same: open -> insta closes as crash.

Does anyone have any suggestions for me?

comments.body: grab logs and put it here
Hi Milos, I found the error by myself via logcat and it's now working, thanks anyway ^^
